name: Website filmed
description: The filmed canvas (ADR-0057, Brief docs/briefs/filmed-canvas.md): the Syntax channel's YouTube Videos page as a screen a documentary camera is filming from low and to the left, close enough that the page runs off every edge. The page is a bundled capture at native density (the filmed framing of website-screenshot, the page anchor putting the middle row of the grid at frame centre); the camera rests on one thumbnail with a wide-open lens, so only that band of the page is sharp and the rows above and below fall away, and pushes in slowly for the whole cut. The page is quoted substrate and Pack-immune; a Pack changes only the light. There is no page entrance — the cut is the entrance — and the piece ends on a cut. Intentional omissions: no Overlays (the page is the piece), no source-url plate, no marks (a captured page has no DOM text), no paper-grain, no legacy camera move on top of the travel.
